subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should this issue be resolved by accepting a larger fixed initial WebChat history window, or should closure require load-older pagination using chat.history offsets?
rationale: Source review can prove the 100-message cap and offset-capable backend, but it cannot choose the intended UI/performance contract for long sessions.

options.title: Require bounded pagination
options.body: Keep the initial payload bounded and close this only when WebChat can load older pages on demand.

options.title: Accept fixed-window mitigation
options.body: Allow the linked fixed-500 PR to close this after real browser proof and maintainer acceptance of the larger startup payload.

recommendation.title: Require bounded pagination
recommendation.body: Keep the initial payload bounded and close this only when WebChat can load older pages on demand.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a Control UI UX/performance product decision, and steipete has adjacent history and UI provenance.
